blurb: Guests rent premium Yamaha WaveRunner jet skis to ride Lake Michigan along the Chicago lakefront, enjoying skyline views. Rentals include fuel, life jackets, and in-person training. No boating license or experience is needed.
extraNote: Weather Concerns: If weather conditions are deemed unsafe, we will offer to reschedule or issue a full refund, decided the morning of operation at the discretion of Skyline Jetski. · Arrive at least 45 minutes before departure; late arrival may result in cancellation without refund · Lake Michigan conditions monitored; unsafe conditions lead to reschedule or refund · Late returns charged $5 per minute · We look forward to having you as our guest! · Diversey Harbor — A Dock, 248 W Diversey Pkwy, Chicago, IL 60614
